reader_summary.overview: Our final segment from the road in the U.K. features two well-known investors and entrepreneurs in the London tech world: Seedcamp co-founder Reshma Sahoni and Shakil Khan (known to all simply as Shak). Reshma and Shak break down the venture scene in London, and describe the particular way the best companies scale in Europe ...
